Description: Resistor 1 kOhm 1% 1/4W, 1206 SMD package, thick film
Notes: Series ballast for the R/G/B test LEDs D1/D2/D3/D4 (anode +12V, cathode -> R -> IO4 signal). Continuous dissipation: ~0.07 W (green/blue) to ~0.10 W (red, lower Vf) at 12 V. 1/4 W (0.25 W) = ~40% load -> runs cool, OK with the LED permanently on. 5% (RC1206JR-071KL / 311-1.0KERCT-ND) is equivalent here.

Description: Resistor 51 Ohm 5% 1W, 2512 SMD package, thick film (schematic value = 50)
Notes: Pull-down for the GND return of each player button (isolation via SWx to +5V). Dissipates ~0.5 W while SWx is held -> 1 W = 50% load: hot spot ~60-80 C with copper on the pads, OK continuously. Footprint ~8x4 mm (half the THT version, zero height). Stock ~23 k. -> PROVIDE copper (ground plane / wide traces) on the pads for thermal performance. Exact 50.0 ohm = wirewound; a true 2W in 2512 = Bourns CRM2512 (~$0.30).
Common anode: B+/R+/G+ (pins 2/4/6) tied together on the PCB. Only SMD component. 100% THT option: Kingbright WP154A4SEJ3VBDZGW/CA (754-2029-ND, ~$2.20).

Description: Tactile pushbutton 6 mm THT momentary, 6.0 mm plunger, 100 gf
Notes: SW1 TEST / SW2 COIN / SW3 SERVICE / SW4 1P SELECT / SW5 2P SELECT. In parallel with J31/J32/J33/J20/J21. Same 6 mm 4-pin footprint as the Omron B3F-1000. Premium alternative: Omron B3F-1000 (SW400-ND, ~$0.40, 1 M cycles, 4.3 mm plunger).

Description: Tactile pushbutton 6 mm THT momentary, 6.0 mm plunger, 100 gf
Notes: Per-player-button isolation: pressing pulls the GND return (J*.3) to +5V -> the input goes back to HIGH (overrides even a stuck button). SW6..SW13 = 1P B1..B8, SW14..SW21 = 2P B1..B8. 21x TS02-66-60-BK-100-LCR-D = ~$2.5 (vs ~$8.4 for Omron B3F-1000). 100,000 cycles, contact rating 50 mA/12 V -> OK for a +5 V signal. 100 gf feel identical to the B3F-1000; plunger 1.7 mm taller (daughter board, cosmetic only). Premium alternative Omron B3F-1000 (SW400-ND, 1 M cycles, 4.3 mm).

Description: JST XH male header 1x03, 2.50 mm pitch, vertical, THT
Notes: 1P/2P buttons B1..B8 (pin 1 = +12V LED, pin 2 = signal, pin 3 = GND return).

Description: JST XH male header 1x02, 2.50 mm pitch, vertical, THT
Notes: 1P/2P SELECT, COIN METER, COIN LOCKOUT, CAMERA LED x2, TEST/COIN/SERVICE BUTTON.

JST XH male header 1x08, 2.50 mm pitch, vertical, THT
Notes: BILLBOARD LED L / R. Old DigiKey P/N 455-2251-ND has been discontinued.

Description: Keyed IDC box header 2x30 (60 pos), 2.54 mm pitch, vertical, THT
Notes: CN3 From IO4 / CN3 To Harness. Or a bare 2x30 header (~0.40) if not using a keyed ribbon cable.

Description: Keyed IDC box header 2x10 (20 pos), 2.54 mm pitch, vertical, THT
Screw terminal block 2 poles, 5.08 mm pitch, THT
Notes: 12 V input. Budget equivalent: Same Sky TB007-508-02BE (~$0.40).

Description: SMD fuse 15 A fast-acting, 125 V, Nano2 / 2410 package
Notes: Overcurrent protection for the 12 V input J22 (in series, input side, before Q1). Direct second source for the Littelfuse 451: same dimensions (6.10 x 2.54 mm), same 2410 land pattern. Rated 15 A as a precaution: only blows on a hard short (real load ~1-2 A). Breaking capacity 50 A AC / 300 A DC -> ample for 12 V. Same-footprint alternatives: Littelfuse 0451015.MRL (F2593CT-ND, ~$3.76, the original); Bourns SF-2410F1500T-2 (~$0.83, ceramic tube, 200 A breaking). Must be desoldered if it blows (no 15 A SMD fuse holder).

Description: P-channel MOSFET -30 V, -17 A, 8.5 mOhm, Vgs +/-20 V, TO-252 (DPAK)
Notes: Reverse-polarity protection as an ideal diode on the 12 V input J22. Wiring: Drain (pad 2 = tab) -> +12 terminal of J22 (via F1), Source (pad 3) -> board +12 V rail, Gate (pad 1) -> R17 -> GND terminal of J22. ~0 V drop when forward. For sustained 15 A (unlikely) provide a copper plane, or set Q1 = Infineon IPD90P04P4L-03 (-40 V, 3.3 mOhm).

Description: Unidirectional TVS diode 1500 W, 15 V standoff, ~24.4 V clamp, SMC (DO-214AB)
Notes: Transient clamping on the 12 V rail, load side (after Q1). Cathode (pad 1) -> +12 V rail, anode (pad 2) -> GND; non-conducting in normal operation. Placed after Q1 so it is protected from reverse polarity. Does NOT protect against a wrong DC voltage (24 V) -> user's responsibility. 600 W version: SMBJ15A-13-F (SMBJ15A-FDICT-ND, SMB package). Tighter clamp if the supply is exactly 12.0 V: SMCJ13A-13-F.
Gate pull-down for Q1 (gate -> GND terminal of J22). Value not critical (10 k to 1 M). Dissipates ~1.4 mW at 12 V. Option: C1 100 nF 0603 gate-to-GND to soften hot switch-on.

Description: Jumper (shunt) 2 pos, 2.54 mm pitch, gold contact, open top
Notes: J34: bridging EXV and 5V if your harness doesn't already do it (mandatory). J35: FiNALE/DX passthrough pin 51 select (mandatory, either position). Also for bridging pin 2 and 3 on the 3-position JST-XH for player buttons 1-8, if no real photo-interrupter are connected this is mandatory. (2.54 mm pitch).

Description: Male pin header strip, 1x40, 2.54 mm pitch, vertical, THT, break-away
Notes: Cut to a 1x02 (J34, EXV-5V jumper) and a 1x03 (J35, FiNALE/DX pin 51 select). One strip covers both with spare pins left over.
